text:
alex: quick flag  CI preflight failed in payments-service: SAST completed but evidence upload to the secure store returned KMS PERMISSION_DENIED. blocked release.

harper: saw this too. ticket created: SEC-6567. logs: https://logs.internal/tx/65678-preflight -> `google.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.GetCryptoKeyVersion: PERMISSION_DENIED`.

tess: immediate mitigation: re-run preflight after issuing ephemeral decrypt token via token-broker. backfill succeeded for the one blocked run.

ben: note: we should add a CI preflight that validates KMS key alias resolution + token TTL matches service expectation. current failure mode is services caching keyVersion instead of using the alias.

alex: proposal: implement a "ci-kms-preflight" job that does: 1) resolve cryptoKey alias 2) attempt a decrypt of a tiny test blob 3) verify CloudAudit log entry includes `x-scan-id`. if any step fails, fail the rotation/release CI early.

harper: also propose an "evidence quarantine" pattern: when KMS errors occur, pipeline writes a small, encrypted JSON to a quarantine bucket with fields {scan_id, repo, run_ts, error, requester}. Quarantine objects are encrypted with a different envelope key and auto-expire in 36h. Quarantine writes must trigger pager immediately.

tess: +1 but quarantine must be strictly audited. require two approvals to enable per-repo and only allowed for org-internal repos. add automated ticketing that marks findings `evidence:provisional`.

ben: for RBAC: prefer a token broker that hands short-lived tokens (TTL=180s) after OPA checks. sample OPA rule: `allow { input.principal == "service:scanner"; input.repo in data.allowed_repos }`. Broker should log `approved_by` and `scan_id`.

alex: small GH Actions snippet we can drop into repos to propagate scan id and run preflight:

```yaml
env:
  SCAN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}-sast-${{ github.sha }}
steps:
  - name: preflight kms check
    run: |
      export SCAN_ID="$SCAN_ID"
      curl -sS https://internal-tooling/ci-kms-preflight?scan_id=$SCAN_ID | jq .status
  - name: run sast
    if: success()
    run: ./ci/run_sast.sh --run-id "$SCAN_ID"
```

harper: audit improvement: tag all KMS RPCs with `scan_id` and `ci_stage` in request metadata so we can query CloudAudit by label. add a lightweight Elastic alert that surfaces any PERMISSION_DENIED where `ci_stage in (preflight, upload)`.

tess: triage flow tweak: when evidence is quarantined mark vulndb entry `provisional-evidence` and create a follow-up that auto-retries ingestion when token-broker grants a new token. If final evidence never arrives within 36h, escalate to sec-oncall.

ben: minor thought: add a canary week after any large SAST ruleset deploy where the new ruleset runs in shadow mode for 48h and preflight runs are enforced. if >3% of runs hit quarantine, auto-rollback the ruleset. call it "shadow-and-preflight" mode.

alex: action items: - alex: implement basic ci-kms-preflight script + PR to tooling (ETA 48h) - harper: draft quarantine schema + alerting + retention policy (ETA EOD) - tess: add OPA rule + token-broker POC (POC 72h) - ben: add CloudAudit label requirements to security runbook (ETA 24h)

sec-bot: automated: incident INC-656789-KMS-QUARANTINE created and assigned to sec-oncall.

harper: one more: include a small diff-check in preflight to catch accidental IAM housekeeping sweeps. preflight should hit a read-only API that returns whether `scanner@` principals still have decrypt rights. fail loud if not.

tess: agreed. will include that check in the OPA evaluation.

alex: thanks team. I'll open the repo PR and link here once preflight is live.

(emoji reactions: :mag: from tess, :white_check_mark: from ben)
